name: fqnovel-desktop
description: FQNovel desktop client with a Node.js core and an isolated Java unidbg worker.
author: FQNovel Desktop Contributors

scripts.pack:win: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run runtime:win:x64 && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run runtime:win:x64 && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --win nsis portable --x64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run runtime:mac:x64 && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --mac dmg zip --x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:worker && npm run runtime:mac:arm64 && node scripts/run-builder.mjs --mac dmg zip --arm64
